jobs.description: Plausity is an AI-native due diligence platform for MundA advisors, private equity and VC funds, and corporate development teams, built in Hamburg. Our clients are buy-side and sell-side teams: PE and VC funds, MundA advisors, Family Offices, consultancies, law firms, lenders and corporates. One Big Four advisory practice reports cutting a mid-market commercial DD from 8 weeks to 2 days with Plausity.- We believe diligence stays an expert s job. Faster deals.What you will do   Deliver diligence (about 60%)- Lead day-to-day execution of commercial and AI due diligence projects on the Plausity platform, from kick-off to final report.- Structure the key questions, build the workplan and own the core workstreams: e.g. market sizing, competitive landscape, customer research, industry experts, business plan review, financial modeling and AI/tech assessment.- Use the platform end to end: e.g. data room analysis, evidence gap detection, findings, primary research, cyber security DD and AI expert interviews.- Turn analysis into a clear, investment-grade storyline and present it to deal teams and investment committees.- Check every AI-generated finding against its source. jobs.occupation: Senior Director (m/f/d) - Digital & AI Manufacturing, Supply Chain & Quality Transformation (Leiter/in - Digitalisierung)
jobs.description: About usThe Senior Director, Digital & AI Manufacturing, Supply Chain & Quality Transformation shapes Fresenius Kabi's future Digital & AI agenda across these functions.Partnering with senior TechOps, Supply Chain and Quality leaders across business units and global functions, the role defines the digital vision for operations beyond 2030: increasingly cloud-native, AI-first, data-driven and digitally enabled.As TechOps leadership's strategic Digital & AI partner, the role owns the Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Quality Trend Radar, continuously assessing emerging technologies, industry developments and disruptive innovations over a 3-5 year horizon. It translates trends into actionable recommendations on organizational implications and industry-leading practices.The role provides end-to-end transparency of the TechOps Digital & AI portfolio as the primary reference for ongoing, planned and emerging initiatives. It identifies, prioritizes and sequences opportunities across Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Quality, guiding investment and recommending whether initiatives should continue, scale, evolve or stop based on strategic relevance, business value and scalability.Working through an agile team of AI & Digital Innovation Acceleration Managers and Business Unit partners, the role translates business challenges and strategic ambitions into Digital & AI use cases. It guides innovation from strategic advisory and opportunity identification through proof-of-value pilots, providing investment and scaling recommendations and decision support.With the Digital & AI Capability and Workforce Strategy & Engagement teams, the role strengthens digital capabilities, adoption and workforce transformation for AI-enabled operations. As an external ambassador, it represents Fresenius Kabi's Digital & AI perspective in Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Quality forums, industry networks and strategic partnerships, aligned with Group and segment stakeholders.Your responsibilitiesShape the Future of Manufacturing, Supply Chain & Quality- Define the Digital & AI vision for Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Quality.- Continuously assess external market trends, emerging technologies and industry best practices.- Identify future capability requirements needed to maintain competitiveness over the next 3-5 years.- Develop strategic roadmaps that balance long-term ambition with practical execution in a complex brownfield environment.Trend Monitoring & Innovation Scouting- Establish a systematic process to identify and assess emerging technologies (e.g., a Trend Radar), and regularly communicate findings to create a shared knowledge base across TechOps and Digital governance bodies.- Build partnerships with technology providers, industry networks, start-ups and academic institutions.- Assess each trend against maturity, relevance for Fresenius Kabi, GxP and regulatory implications, cross-BU scalability and business value, with a clear recommendation to act, pilot, monitor or discontinue, informed by benchmarking, vendor and start-up scouting, and industry networks.Digital Portfolio Ownership & Synergy Realization- Own the portfolio of Digital & AI initiatives across Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Quality and maintain transparency of the digital maturity landscape across production units as the foundation for scaling decisions.- Identify duplication, capability gaps and synergies; recommend consolidation, reuse or scaling opportunities; and prioritize investments based on business value, strategic importance and operational feasibility.Big Bets, Use Cases & Proof of Value- Identify high-value AI opportunities across manufacturing, planning, logistics, quality and engineering.- Shape high-impact use cases together with Business Unit Digital Partners, including value cases, success criteria and committed business sponsors.- Functionally lead an agile delivery team during the Proof of Value (PoV) phase, own the go/no-go decision gate following PoV completion and ensure a scalable transition into TechOps functions and Kabi IT.- Steer value realization throughout broader deployment and support the development of reference and lighthouse sites that make the future-state vision tangible (e.g., Factory of the Future).Lead Business Transformation- Serve as a trusted advisor and single point of entry into Digital & AI for senior TechOps stakeholders across Business Units; facilitate cross-BU strategic dialogue and support preparation of related executive leadership decisions.- Ensure global solutions are designed for reuse and scalability across sites, regions and business units.- Align business, Digital & AI and technology stakeholders around common objectives. Act as the key interface to Kabi IT, Fresenius Digital Technology, Data & Analytics, Quality and Regulatory Affairs; lead through expertise and relationships while proactively identifying strategic risks and escalating significant deviations.- Leverage Enablement and Transformation resources within the team to strengthen digital capabilities, drive adoption and support the workforce transformation required for AI-enabled operations.Your qualifications- University degree; MBA a plus.- At least 10 years of relevant Supply Chain, Manufacturing or Quality experience, including significant experience in global pharmaceutical, life sciences, medical technology, chemical or similarly regulated manufacturing.- Proven success leading large-scale digital or operational transformations, building business cases and securing executive investment sponsorship.- Strong knowledge of TechOps systems (ERP, MES, LIMS/QMS, PLM, automation, shop-floor connectivity and planning) and modern data/AI architectures, with the technical fluency to challenge estimates independently.- Hands-on brownfield experience with fragmented processes, systems and data, and experience in international matrix organizations spanning multiple business units and production sites.- Fluent written and spoken English; German or other languages an advantage.- Willingness to travel internationally (30-40%)What we offerDrive the future of our company — join #futurefresenius and make an impact!ContactApply now through our online portal.Apply now (https://apply.jcd.de/Apply.php?iJobAdID=108709&tc=3-11)

jobs.occupation: Technical Sales & Product Manager (m/w/d) (Fachberater/in - Vertrieb)
jobs.description: About UsVirtue Intelligence GmbH is an internationally operating technology company headquartered in Darmstadt, Germany. We specialize in electronic components, semiconductors, Internet of Things (IoT) solutions, industrial networking, and embedded systems.By combining international sourcing capabilities, technical expertise, and strong partnerships with manufacturers and development teams, we provide electronic components and customized technology solutions to customers across Germany and Europe.To support our continued business expansion, we are seeking an experienced and results-driven Technical Sales & Business Development Manager.The primary focus of this role is to develop our electronic components and semiconductor business, while actively expanding our customer base and identifying new opportunities in IoT solutions and industrial networking products.Key Responsibilities1. Sales & Business Development- Identify and acquire new customers across Germany and Europe, particularly OEMs, ODMs, EMS providers, system integrators, and industrial manufacturers.- Develop and maintain long-term customer relationships and strategic accounts.- Drive sales of electronic components, including semiconductors, integrated circuits (ICs), active and passive components, connectors, and related products.- Actively develop new customers and business opportunities for IoT devices, embedded systems, and industrial networking solutions.- Promote industrial Ethernet switches, industrial routers, 4G/5G communication devices, asset trackers, sensors, and customized hardware solutions.- Identify potential customers in industrial automation, logistics, telecommunications, smart infrastructure, and other relevant industries.- Manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and customer inquiries to quotations, negotiations, and contract closure.- Achieve agreed revenue, gross margin, and business development targets.2. Electronic Components Sales & Customer Support- Manage customer inquiries, Requests for Quotation (RFQs), Bills of Materials (BOMs), and component sourcing requirements.- Prepare competitive quotations and negotiate pricing, delivery schedules, and commercial terms.- Support customers in sourcing hard-to-find, shortage, and end-of-life (EOL) components.- Identify design-in opportunities and provide technical and commercial support during component selection.- Collaborate with international manufacturers, distributors, and supply partners.- Identify cross-selling opportunities and expand business with existing customers.- Support customers throughout the entire purchasing process, from initial inquiry to successful delivery.3. Product Management & Technical Solutions- Support the management and development of selected product portfolios, including electronic components, IoT devices, and industrial networking products.- Identify new products and technologies based on customer requirements, market trends, and business opportunities.- Evaluate manufacturer and partner solutions regarding technical suitability, commercial competitiveness, and market potential.- Support technical discussions, product selection, design-in activities, and customized hardware development.- Define product requirements in collaboration with customers, engineering teams, and development partners.- Contribute to product roadmaps, business cases, pricing strategies, and go-to-market activities.- Support new product introductions and product lifecycle management.4. International Supplier & Project Coordination- Establish and maintain relationships with international manufacturers, distributors, and technology partners.- Coordinate product specifications, pricing, availability, delivery schedules, and technical requirements.- Act as an interface between customers, suppliers, engineering teams, purchasing, and logistics.- Support customer-specific development projects and technical evaluations.- Coordinate IoT and industrial networking projects from initial requirements through product delivery.- Assist in resolving technical, quality-related, and supply chain issues.5. Market Analysis & Strategic Business Development- Monitor market trends, technology developments, pricing, and competitive activities in the electronics industry.- Identify emerging opportunities in electronic components, IoT, and industrial communication markets.- Explore potential new product categories, suppliers, and strategic partnerships.- Develop sales strategies and support go-to-market plans for new products and solutions.- Represent Virtue Intelligence at trade fairs, industry exhibitions, and customer events.- Maintain accurate customer information, sales opportunities, and project records in CRM systems.- Prepare regular sales forecasts, pipeline updates, and business development reports.Qualifications & RequirementsProfessional Qualifications- Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Telecommunications, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.- At least three years of professional experience in electronic component sales, semiconductor distribution, technical sales, or business development.- Proven experience in new customer acquisition and B2B relationship development.- Solid knowledge of electronic components, semiconductors, and the electronics supply chain.- Experience working with OEMs, ODMs, EMS providers, electronics manufacturers, or industrial customers.- Familiarity with RFQs, BOM analysis, component sourcing, pricing negotiations, and customer project management.- An established customer network within the German or European electronics industry is highly desirable.- Experience working with electronic component distributors, semiconductor manufacturers, or international technology partners is an advantage.Additional Technical Expertise – Preferred- Knowledge of IoT technologies, embedded systems, or industrial networking.- Familiarity with industrial Ethernet switches, routers, and industrial communication solutions.- Understanding of wireless and cellular technologies, including 4G, 5G, LTE-M, and NB-IoT.- Experience with IoT devices, asset tracking, sensors, or wireless communication modules.- Experience in technical product management, design-in projects, or customized electronic solutions.Experience in IoT and industrial networking is considered a strong advantage but is not mandatory. Proven electronic component sales experience and customer development capabilities remain the primary selection criteria.Personal Skills- Strong sales orientation, commercial awareness, and negotiation skills.- Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive and results-driven approach.- Ability to work independently and manage multiple customers and projects.- Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.- Customer-focused attitude and willingness to develop long-term business partnerships.- Ability to collaborate effectively with international customers, suppliers, and engineering teams.- Willingness to travel for customer meetings, trade shows, and occasional international business trips.Language Requirements- German: Native-level proficiency, both written and spoken.- English: Excellent communication skills, both written and spoken.- Additional Languages: Proficiency in other European languages is considered a strong advantage.- Chinese language skills are an advantage but not mandatory.What We Offer- A challenging and rewarding role combining technical sales, business development, and product management.- The opportunity to expand our electronic components business and develop new markets for IoT and industrial networking solutions.- An international business environment with access to manufacturers, suppliers, and technology partners.- Direct collaboration with company management and short decision-making processes.- A high degree of autonomy and the opportunity to shape new business activities.- Flexible working arrangements and remote work options by agreement.- Competitive base salary with performance-based incentives, subject to agreement.-
